item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We work to prevent that outcome. We need a ban on superintelligence—not a race to build it first.

2. We cannot protect humanity by racing to build the technology that will destroy it. Superintelligence built with anything like current techniques will kill everyone on Earth. We need to stop that race and ban its destination.

3. We want a future in which people are alive to make choices, raise children, and build better lives. Superintelligence built with anything like current techniques will end that future. We demand a ban before anyone builds it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We work toward a ban on superintelligence for a plain reason: if anyone builds it with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We will not accept human extinction as the price of technological progress. We want progress that leaves people alive to enjoy it, and a future that belongs to humanity—not one cut short by a race no one can afford to win. Our task is to turn that conviction into public understanding and enforceable policy. In this newsletter, we share the work we are doing to stop the race toward superintelligence and build support for a ban before anyone crosses that line.
